title: How Many Merges Until the Final Form? 🌌
description:
Comment A, B, C or D 👇 How many merges until dust becomes a black hole?

Band A is under 38 merges, B is 38 to 45, C is 46 to 53, D is 54 and up. Pick one before the first merge! Six forms: dust, rock, moon, planet, star, black hole. The same form pulls the same form, and two of a kind that touch merge into one body a tier up. Different forms bounce off each other. New dust drifts in from the rim faster and faster, the view pulls back as things grow, and the counter counts every merge. The run ends the moment the first black hole forms, and the band that holds the final count wins. A band is crossed out when the counter passes its top edge. It is a toy model, not astrophysics.
Everything here is generated by code (seed 193), with no footage, samples or stock media.
Which band did you pick?
